summary: A realtime duel on Comet Catcher: one Opus 5.5 medium player (Armada, G1) under an Opus 5.5 high commander against u6bkep (Armada, B5), lost by the commander's surrender at 15:26. The first raid body ran straight at his plant and died piecemeal to his Blitz pairs at B4-D4 (2:35-4:17, 502 lost for 220), and from 4:16 the player kept every unit at home while his packs of 5-7 Blitzes raided our middle spots F2/F3/G4 from 5:24 and won the Blitz mirror there (3,167 lost for 2,090 by 7:50). Our extractors stood at 8-9 from 4:32 to 12:00 (pool median 13 at 7:00, 17 at 10:00) because the expansion lists ran into his raid lanes while the south-east stayed empty until 11:20; a push west ordered at 7:59 was held by the hands and dropped by the player at 8:18, though his south was bare (a lone Rover killed three of his extractors at B7-A8 at 9:30-9:56). He switched to Stouts and Janus, won the E1 Stout fight (9:32-10:34, 2,060 lost for 1,155), hit spot_11 with about 3.2k at 11:37, killed our plant at 12:12 while the hands kept our commander out of the fight, and razed both bases by 14:18. Neither side went to tier 2, and no person commented on the game in the chat.

root.what: The reader's reading (no person reviewed this game). After the first raid body died piecemeal (2:35-4:17), the player brought every Blitz home as one home guard at spot_11 and gated the raid on eight or more, against the commander's 'stay in his half'. From then our mass never went over 4% into his half while his was in ours every minute he was seen. His Blitz packs chose every fight at our middle spots F2/F3/G4 from 5:24, took 8 extractors by 8:05, and held ours at 8-9 to 12:00. The south-east stayed empty and his south stood unraided. Everything after (the Stout fight at E1, the plant at 12:12) is the cost of that income gap.

our_mistakes.what: The army was brought home and stood at spot_11, spot_18 and then spot_6 through 9:00, giving him the middle; this is the root. A stronger player keeps one body forward in the middle, or raids his outer spots, so his raiders have to go home. This is the reader's reading. The commander asked for 'stay in his half' (3:20) and 'goes west at once' (4:50, 6:20, 7:50), but at 4:50 it also accepted gathering first.
our_mistakes.evidence: minutes.py rows 5-11: our mass E3, G1, G1, G1, G1, F2, F1 at 2-4% in his half; 6:42 note: 'Not going west yet against the direction'; 7:20: "Direction's 'go west now' not followed"

our_mistakes.what: The expansion order sent every constructor into the middle (F2, F3, F1, G4), where his raids ran, with a clause sending a constructor home whenever an enemy party was in reach. The nine spots of the south-east were left out. They were first named by the commander at 9:20, and the first was started at 11:20.

their_play: Armada vehicles throughout. Blitz pairs held the middle (C4/D4) from about 3:00, with light turrets at A4 and B5 by 3:00 (A6 and B8 later), and killed our first raiders one at a time. From 5:24 packs of 5-7 Blitzes raided our middle spots F2/F3/F4/G4 and took 8 extractors by 8:05; whenever he was seen from 5:00 on, his mass was in our half. About 23 of his Blitzes died by 8:08, but the raids held our economy flat. By 9:00 he had moved to Stouts with some Janus (3 Stouts at spot_3 at 9:09) and won the E1 fight at 9:32-10:34. He hit spot_11 at 11:37 with about 11 Stouts, 2 Janus and 2 Blitzes, killed the plant at 12:12, razed G1 with a 10-16 unit block at 12:53-13:34, broke the second plant at H3 by 14:18 and swept the south-east to 15:28 (about 5,100 of army seen at the end). His south (B7, B8, A8) stood bare at 9:30-9:56. No tier 2 and no aircraft were seen, and at most 3 of his extractors were ever in sight at once (no truth file).

bears_on.note: 8-9 extractors from 4:32 to 12:00, all in the raided middle; the never-raided south-east (nine spots) was empty until 11:20.
Our chat line named the Stout push ('Your Stout push broke us'), but the commander's last note and the curves put the loss on extractors flat from 5:00, minutes before the push.
His south was bare while his army raided us: one Rover killed three of his extractors at 9:30-9:56. The 7:59 push aimed there was dropped at 8:18.
Both first handfuls crossed (our Rover 2:03, raid 2:35). His Blitz pairs won the middle and kept raiding; ours died at his plant and stayed home from 4:16. The side that kept up pressure won.
Blitzes fed singly 3:40-4:17, hunts of 4 and 2 at home at 6:08, the E1 body walking off and back at 9:48-10:01: each lost with even or better metal on the spot.
2-4k metal of wrecks safe to work in our half 8:00-12:00 (bot.log) against six reclaim plays, while the extractors sat at 8-9.
Three solars and a constructor first, as the lesson intends, but three extractors before them put the plant at 1:04 (pool 0:34) and the energy stalled 2:00-2:17.
Energy store empty 18.9% of the game; first construction turret 8:47 against the pool's 5:56.
In the Armada mirror we moved to Stouts first (5:05, mostly Stouts from 6:42) and he moved by 9:00. The Stout fights went to the larger, joined body, not to whoever switched first.

bears_on.note: The ball came home at 4:16 and stayed. The 7:59 push was dropped for count gates (8, then 10 Stouts) that never fired. The E1 body fought strung out.

bears_on.note: Constructors were at or above the pool (5 at 6:00, >p75), yet extractors fell below p25 from 7:00: the spot order, not the constructor count, set the income.

bears_on.id: The raid answer: who answers a raider, pickets, the turret with the spot, the 600 rule
bears_on.note: A limit: 13 light turrets by 8:00 (the pool's p75) and 24 of 27 lost extractors with a turret within 700. One turret a spot did not stop packs of 5-7 Blitzes, and the home body answered with detachments.

bears_on.id: The commander's conduct: fights at home, builds at the plant, never toward what outreaches it, the early army
bears_on.note: The 'never toward what outreaches it' rule kept the commander out of the plant fight at 12:06-12:12 against the packet, and the plant died. Whether the D-gun would have saved it is not shown.

bears_on.id: Energy in the opening: solars before and with the plant, the metal-bound first four minutes, the solar rule, the commander on the plant
bears_on.note: Plant at 1:04 after 3 extractors and 3 solars, stall4 45 s, factory units by 4:00 below p25. The commander assisted 106 s by 4:00 (good).

lens.caveats: No review.md, but impedance-review.md (2026-10-16) and unfinished-review.md (2026-10-17) sit in the match directory and were built on; their item numbers are cited. No truth file: his army and extractors are floors, so the minutes.py windows at 1.8-7.4x are seen-army floors, not a lead (the commander counted 691 against 770 seen at 4:50). No ledger row for human-28. pro_baseline found no carded side for G1 at OS 40+ and ran with --all-starts; its pressure rows read '-' though minutes.py has a Rover in his half at 2:03 (likely the tool's his-half test needs a truth file). bot.log's wreck line '0 at work' does not count the hands' reclaim plays. No person's words on this game: the causes are the reader's and the two models' (the player's notes, the commander's last note).

open_questions: Would one body stationed forward at F2-E3 from 4:16 (instead of spot_11/spot_6) have held the middle spots against his packs of 5-7 Blitzes, given the hands' detachments?
How far ahead was he on extractors at 8:00 and 12:00? No truth file; the engine replay, if it is in the user's BAR install, could be read with run/replay_match.py.
Was his south bare already at 8:00 (would the 7:59 push to spot_61/67/62 have paid), or only by 9:30?
Would the commander's D-gun at 12:06-12:12 have saved the plant against about 11 Stouts?
Why did the 0:11 spot order leave out the never-raided south-east (spot_42, 48, 51, 57, 60, 65, 70, 72), and would the map sheet have offered it?
